footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Farmland Partners: includes a $15K income tax benefit; after $627K attributable to noncontrolling interests, $2.7M of preferred dividends. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 10.4% to $52.2M in 2025. Operating income fell 78.8% to $5.2M, a 10.0% margin.
Net income fell 49.0% to $28.8M, or $0.61 per share. Operating cash flow was $17.4M and free cash flow $17.4M, versus $16.1M; Farmland Partners returned $102M through dividends and buybacks.
watch: Net income includes a $15K tax benefit.
sources: Farmland Partners Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
